People: Frederic Shoberl (author, Wikidata Q5497135), died 1853. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Shoberl, Frederic, 1775-1853") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Narrative Of The Most Remarkable Events Which Occurred In And Near Leipzig, Eighth Edition, 1814, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/NarrativeOfTheMostRemarkableEventsWhichOccurredInAndNearLeipzigEighthEdition. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 86%, 92%, 85% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Frederic Shoberl, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
